notes:
Added

  • Perk damage dice. When a weapon's damage is rolled, the dice from the character's perks and magazines go into the damage dialog's Extra Dice, which the system doesn't charge ammunition for, and the dialog lists where each die came from. It works from the system's sheet as well as the Pip-Boy.
    • Added automatically: Laser Commander, Commando, Rifleman, Gunslinger, Size Matters, Iron Fist, Pyromaniac, Nerd Rage!, and the learned Deadly Lasers!, The Starlet Sniper!, Surrounded by the Dead! (while spending ammunition) and Nuke-the-Man! (for the whole party).
    • Offered as checkboxes: sneak attacks, Blitz, attacks against a kind of enemy, and the once-only magazines, once when read and once a scene when learned.
    • New world settings: Perk Damage Dice, on by default, and the Fire-Based Weapons Pyromaniac counts.
  • Ammunition log. A new world setting, Ammunition Log (off by default), whispers the GMs every time ammunition is spent: whose, how much, and the attack or damage roll that spent it, with its Fire Rate and Extra Dice. Each roll is checked against what the system's own rules say it should cost, and an entry is flagged in red when more was taken.

Changed

  • Dice bought with AP for damage are now added to Extra Dice rather than written over it, so they sit alongside the perk dice.
